title: Local Superior Soups: A Catalyst for Model Merging in Cross-Silo Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2410.23660v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a learning paradigm that enables collaborative training of models using decentralized data. Recently, the utilization of pre-trained weight initialization in FL has been demonstrated to effectively improve model performance. However, the evolving complexity of current pre-trained models, characterized by a substantial increase in parameters, markedly intensifies the challenges associated with communication rounds required for their adaptation to FL. To address these communication cost issues and increase the performance of pre-trained model adaptation in FL, we propose an innovative model interpolation-based local training technique called ``Local Superior Soups.'' Our method enhances local training across different clients, encouraging the exploration of a connected low-loss basin within a few communication rounds through regularized model interpolation. translated_title: 局部优越汤：跨筒仓联邦学习中模型合并的催化剂
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种利用分散数据进行模型协同训练的学习范式。最近，在联邦学习中使用预训练权重初始化已被证明能够有效提升模型性能。然而，当前预训练模型日益增长的复杂性（表现为参数量的大幅增加）显著加剧了将预训练模型适配到联邦学习所需的通信轮次的挑战。为了解决这些通信成本问题并提升预训练模型在联邦学习中的适配性能，我们提出了一种创新的基于模型插值的本地训练技术，称为“局部优越汤”。我们的方法增强了不同客户端的本地训练，通过正则化模型插值，在少量通信轮次内促进对连通低损失盆地的探索。该方法作为催化剂，实现了预训练模型向联邦学习的无缝适配。
tldr: 提出了一种基于模型插值的本地训练技术“局部优越汤”，通过正则化模型插值在少量通信轮次内引导客户端探索连通的低损失盆地，从而降低跨筒仓联邦学习中预训练模型适配的通信成本并提升性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Local Superior Soups," a novel model interpolation-based local training technique that uses regularized model interpolation to explore connected low-loss basins within few communication rounds, thereby reducing communication costs and improving pre-trained model adaptation in cross-silo federated learning.
